services.name: 3 Hour Private Water Sports Charter
services.desc: Description: This three-hour charter is perfect for 4-6 riders to learn wakesurfing, wakeboarding, or water skiing. Each boat holds up to 10 people, so bring your crew and spectators along! Your charter is fully customizable—we can switch between wakesurfing, wakeboarding, water skiing, swimming, and cruising the lake at any time during your booking. Our professional captain and coach, along with quality gear, ensure a memorable adventure. Relax and let us handle the boat, navigation, and logistics while you focus on having fun and progressing your skills with better techniques and new tricks! --- What is Included: Professional captain and coach providing instruction tailored to all skill

services.name: Sunday Shred
services.desc: Description: Join us for our Sunday Shred Sessions, the ultimate mixed group surf club experience! Sunday Shred is the perfect opportunity to meet some new like-minded friends, regardless of your skill level. Each surfer will enjoy a dedicated 20-minute session with as much coaching as you want. --- Number of Riders: Each Sunday Shred session accommodates up to 6 guests. Book individually or bring your friends! Guests for Sunday Shred must be 13 or older. --- What is Included: Professional captain and coach providing instruction tailored to all skill levels Minimum of 20 minutes of riding and on water instruction Premium Phase 5 wakesurfing equipment State of the art MasterCraft tow boat
